question: I renewed my passport. Can I still fly to Canada using the eTA linked to my old passport?
generated_answer:
You cannot use an eTA linked to your old passport if you have renewed your passport. It is important that you ensure your passport is valid for the duration of your trip. If you travel to Canada using an eTA linked to your old passport, you will have issues getting past the border. If your passport was stolen, you should report this to your local police station. If you have applied for a new passport, you should submit a new eTA application. This ensures your eTA is linked to your new passport number. Note: If you submit your eTA application with an invalid passport number, you will not be able to use your eTA when you travel to Canada. II. Applying for an eTA

What is the cost of an eTA? The eTA fee is CAN$7. To complete your eTA application, you must pay the fee. The fee will be charged to your credit card after you submit your application. This is the only payment required and you will not be contacted for additional payment. If you do not have a credit card, some applicants can pay with someone else’s card. You can only enter your eTA application information once. Make sure you have all the necessary documents before you begin. Note: There are unscrupulous individuals and companies that may offer to submit eTA applications on behalf of others for a fee. Be aware that third parties that are not directly associated with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) or the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA) may provide misleading and inaccurate information and advice and charge fees for services that IRCC and CBSA provide for free. See the section on fraud prevention for more information. How do I apply for an eTA? You must have your passport, a credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) or a Visa debit card, and an email address to apply online. You can only apply for one person at a time. For example, if you have a family of four, you must complete and submit four separate applications. How long will it take? You can usually find out right away if an eTA is approved after you submit the form online. We send most eTA approvals (via email) within minutes. However, the application may need more time to process if you are asked to submit supporting documents. You will receive an email with instructions on what to do next. What do I need to apply for an eTA? If you are applying for an eTA, you will need the following to complete your application form online:

A valid passport or travel document. If you are applying for an eTA, you will need the following to complete your application form online:

A valid passport or travel document. You must apply with the passport you will use to travel to Canada. Note: You cannot submit an application for a new passport and an eTA at the same time. You must wait for your new passport to arrive before you apply for an eTA. If you travel to Canada using a passport that is different from the one you used to get your eTA, you will have issues getting past the border. If you do not have a passport or your passport is due to expire soon, you should renew your passport or get a new one before you apply for an eTA. Valid credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express)

You must use a valid credit card to pay the eTA fee. Your application cannot be processed if you do not pay. You will need to enter the card number, expiry date and the security code. Note: You will only be charged the fee after you submit your application. You may need to submit additional documents after you submit your application before an eTA is granted. In this case, you will receive an email with instructions on what to do next. A personal email address

You must provide a valid email address in your eTA application. We will use this email address to:

confirm that you have received your eTA

send you important updates about your eTA application

You will get an email from the IRCC eTA Helpdesk: [ccl.eta.hd@cic.gc.ca]. This is not a scam or spam. It is important that you do not delete this email and add this email address to your contact list. You will need to refer to this email address in the future to contact us about your eTA application. Note: If you do not use a valid email address, you may miss important updates about your eTA application. You must also respond to any emails you receive from [ccl.eta.hd@cic.gc.ca] in order to avoid any delays to your application. If you do not respond to our email, your eTA application may be cancelled. See the section on fraud prevention for more information on how to avoid eTA application fraud.
